status: source construction and generated validation; authentic preparation and runtime qualification pending

authority.state_and_refit: Persistent permitted past within one animal, resets between animals/folds, and one frozen refit on all four non-query folds after selection are selected. Source-declared 26-MGN-animal grouping is accepted with the unknown-alias limitation.

scientific_claim: Predict processed extracellular regional response rates under an explicit prespecified-window observation assumption. This is a new benchmark endpoint, not reproduction of the original paper or proof of verified physiological silence.
preserved_original_gap: Verified physiological observation coverage remains unresolved. No recording duration is inferred from spikes, click stops or histology timestamps.

support.zero_rule: A missing region or zero cluster denominator is unsupported. A zero deposited-event count in an eligible cell is conditional on assumed support, not independently verified neuronal silence.
support.identity: The paper reports26 MGN mice and the authenticated MGN roster has26 unique source subject identifiers. Their source-declared animal grouping is accepted, with unknown aliases retained as a limitation; no grouping is inferred from dates, prefixes or demographics. Known crossarchive HK210212 overlap is outside MGN-only scope. Any later discovered alias must remain within one fold. Declared identity is not independent biological verification. Multiple sessions would need a qualified chronology schedule before the one-asset cursor can be extended.

target.units: deposited spike events per retained source cluster per nominal second
target.primary: equal animal, then available region, then trial, then bin MSE
secondary: same hierarchy MSE after averaging each consecutive five 1-ms rates into 20 five-ms rates
target.reference: region-specific animal-balanced final-training mean with explicit animal/region-balanced global fallback for unseen regions

conditions.canonical_projection: condition.project emits identical semantic observations for a future viewer or programme adapter in the same information condition. Raw unit spikes and response gold are evaluator-only.
conditions.viewer_status: canonical input source seam only; no graphical renderer, viewer/provider runtime or native AI run is qualified
conditions.programme_status: canonical input and prediction source seam only; no candidate process containment or actual programme run is qualified
conditions.demonstration_budget: Not yet bound. Full-training programmes and limited-demonstration viewers must have separately labelled information budgets; their difference is not an isolated tool-use effect.
conditions.state: sequential within-animal prediction using only already permitted observations and prior own predictions; reset between animals and folds; no query response feedback
conditions.folds: Five outer folds; selected animal-ID hash namespace; next fold for selection validation, other three for initial training; one frozen final refit on all four non-query folds; candidate procedure fixed before all outer folds; no outer scores until every prediction locks

implemented: strict pinned metadata decoding and full support joins
explicit selected protocol and declared fold construction
pure half-open event counting and nominal-denominator preparation
known-gap and cross-trial history/response overlap rejection
whitelisted paired observation projection and chronological prediction locking
complete prediction admission before private gold access
ragged animal/region scoring and competent mean reference
not_qualified: authentic click timestamp membership and onset semantics on the deposited spike clock
authentic neural-array preparation or any scientific score
independent observation continuity or biological identity
process-level fold isolation, state resets, candidate containment and private-gold secrecy
graphical viewer parity, demonstration-budget parity, native AI performance or SOTA
full_cohort_reference_scorer_cost: Unmeasured. Exact rational reference arithmetic prioritizes correctness; generated tiny fixtures do not establish production runtime.
retrospective_limit: Released sorting and eligibility may use whole-session information; sequential permitted-input delivery is not proof of strictly online preprocessing.
contamination_limit: The original study data are public. This source construction does not establish hidden test-data secrecy.
